insight: Its five Korean co-founders met in military cyber-ops; Nvidia made its first direct investment in a Korean AI startup here.
name: TwelveLabs
tagline: Video intelligence API: search, classify, and summarize video.
description: Video understanding platform built on its own multimodal foundation models — Marengo for embeddings and semantic search, Pegasus for generative tasks like summaries and captions. Developers index video once and run natural-language search, classification, and analysis via API. Free tier with usage-based pricing beyond it.
edge: Video-native foundation models (Marengo, Pegasus) understand motion and events directly, not by captioning sampled frames into a text LLM.
cons: Usage costs scale with video volume
